verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise him from the heavens! Praise him way up high!
Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his armies!
Praise him, sun and moon! Every shining star, praise him!
Praise him, highest heavens, and you waters above the skies!
Let them praise the LORD's name. He spoke the command, and there they were.
He set them in place forever and ever. The order he gave will never expire.
Praise the LORD from the earth, you giant sea creatures and all you ocean depths!
Lightning and hail, snow and clouds, storm winds that do what he says,
mountains and hills, fruit trees and every cedar,
wild animals and livestock, little creatures and birds on the wing,
kings of the earth and people everywhere, rulers and all the judges on earth,
young men and young women, old men and children too.
Let them all praise the LORD's name. His name alone is lifted high. His glory rises over earth and heaven.
He's lifted up his people's strength and given his faithful ones reason to praise. That's Israel, the people he holds close. Praise the LORD!
